rows.detail_main_html:
Mass Mental Focus

Psionicist · Level 55 · Alteration

Effect

Untaps the unlocked power of your target's mind revealing hidden strengths. While in this advanced state of focus the target will experience enhanced wisdom, intelligence, movement speed, ability speed, accuracy, evasion, energy regeneration, and, mental and arcane resistance.

Notes

Level 51 and above. The VGO Emulator client these readings are taken from currently stops at level 50, so this ability cannot be checked against the game the way the lower ranks were. Its figures come from the sources credited below and stand unverified for that reason, not because they are in doubt.
